<function name="GetName" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the "targetname" of this entity, typically used in map making and scripting to uniquely identify and target (hence 'targetname') an entity or a group of entities.

<warning>For players, this function is overwritten by <page>Player:GetName</page>, which returns the player's nick name, not the target name.</warning>
</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="string">The name of the Entity</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints the name of an entity in console.</description>
	<code>
function PrintEntityName( ent )
	print( ent:GetName() )
end
	</code>

</example>
